# Asset provenance

- `assets/source/key-art-master-final.png`: generated with OpenAI's built-in
  image generation tool from the prompt recorded in `assets/PROMPTS.md`; a
  protected cross-like emblem was removed in a targeted second generation.
- `assets/source/poster-art-master.png`: generated with OpenAI's built-in image
  generation tool from the recorded portrait prompt.
- Logos, marks, typography, layouts, social cards, and web assets are
  repository-native SVG, HTML, CSS, and deterministic ImageMagick derivatives.
- No stock photography, third-party logos, real-city reference images, or
  participant solution screenshots are included.

The publisher must choose and record the distribution license before external
publication. This file records production origin; it does not grant a license.
